Remark
[polar-cone volume comparison]

Source: petersen:page-0326 ↗ lem:pet-ch7-absolute-volume-comparison 1. ch7:7.5.19For $p\in M$ and $\Gamma \subset T_pM$ a set of unit vectors, define the polar cone $B^\Gamma (p,R)=\{ (t,\theta )\in M\mid t\le R,\ \theta \in \Gamma \} $. If $\Ric M\ge (n-1)k$, show \[ \vol B^\Gamma (p,R)\le \vol \Gamma \cdot \int _0^R(\snk _k(t))^{n-1}\, dt. \]
